data.name: AdminChat.Memory.StorageNotice

data.name: AdminChat.Memory.Notice
data.value: Off: no retrieval or learning. Read-only: retrieval only. Learn: updates on explicit preferences, remember or correction cues. Private user-global + current Workspace scopes; expired/archive entries excluded. Budget: 1000 tokens, Core up to 300; unknown models use a conservative estimate. Never store secrets or sensitive information.
